title: feat: tidy the free limit page to shorten the sign-in
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Simplified the Classic free-limit pages for images and text replies. They now say “Free limit reached,” show the existing limits of 1 free image every 45 seconds or 1 free reply every 30 seconds, and reload when the wait ends instead of displaying a countdown. A “Skip the wait” section presents sign-in and Weft payment options; the sign-in link goes directly to Enter’s sign-in page with ref=classic. The page also uses icons from @pollinations/ui.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, a retro screen says “Free limit reached” beside two friendly paths: a GitHub sign-in sign and a small wallet icon, while a sprout grows where a countdown clock used to be. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny scarf and points toward the paths, small within the scene. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518).
